ecosystem.notes: Bookings is a non-GAAP measure (sales of Robux and subscriptions, before deferral). Roblox records revenue gross, as principal, so Revenue includes the money later paid to developers; developer exchange fees are an expense line, defined as "the amount earned by developers and creators on the Roblox Platform that are qualified and registered in the Developer Exchange Program." Revenue / Bookings therefore overstates what Roblox keeps. Developer exchange fees are the expense recognised in 2024, not necessarily cash paid in 2024.
ecosystem.ratioNote: Roblox records revenue gross, so revenue already includes amounts later paid to developers; the share would understate what creators receive.
